items.title: LangChain and NVIDIA Launch NemoClaw Deep Agents Blueprint
items.summary_1line: LangChain and NVIDIA launch the NemoClaw Deep Agents blueprint, combining Deep Agents Code, Nemotron 3 Ultra, and OpenShell for open, governed enterprise agents.
items.editor_note: LangChain's companion post: the NemoClaw blueprint combining Deep Agents Code, Nemotron 3 Ultra, and OpenShell.

editorial.tldr: LangChain's June newsletter previewed Deep Agents Rubrics and programmatic subagents as building blocks for its orchestration harness. On July 8, LangChain and NVIDIA turned that groundwork into a joint product: the NemoClaw Deep Agents blueprint pairing the harness with Nemotron 3 Ultra.
editorial.whats_new: LangChain and NVIDIA launched the NemoClaw Deep Agents blueprint, tuning LangChain's harness for Nemotron 3 Ultra with benchmark results claiming lower cost than top closed models.
editorial.why_it_matters: Platform engineers get a published, open reference stack — LangChain's harness plus open-weight Nemotron 3 Ultra and OpenShell — as an alternative to wiring a closed-model agent deployment from scratch.
editorial.take_for_builders: Evaluating open-weight agent stacks: pull the NemoClaw blueprint (LangChain Deep Agents harness + Nemotron 3 Ultra + OpenShell) as a reference before building a custom orchestration layer, and check NVIDIA's benchmark methodology before trusting the cost/performance claims.
